Narrative review chapter, not a primary estimate.
Bauman commodification thesis; the mechanism stated qualitatively.
Normative philosophy, no estimate. BUT documents that Iran and Japan launched STATE-RUN dating apps explicitly to raise fertility — a policy fact the chapter should cite in its framing.
Handbook chapter.

Market-metaphor / commodification limb.

Stigma toward app users; outcome is impression and attraction.

Alternatives / investment model — the abundance limb of v5's mechanism.
Choice architecture and algorithmic control on relational decisions.

Fleeting intimacies; weak design (YouTube content analysis).

App use and stress/anxiety/depression; overlaps D.3.a.

Search strategies among online daters.
